text.en: AlphaFold DB is row 113 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the AI4Science area.
text.zh: AlphaFold DB 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 113 行，所属领域为“AI for Science”。

text.en: The annual table associates AlphaFold DB with “AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: massively expanding the structural coverage of protein-sequence space with high-accuracy models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 AlphaFold DB 与论文《AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: massively expanding the structural coverage of protein-sequence space with high-accuracy models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Mihaly Varadi, Demis Hassabis, Sameer Velankar”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Mihaly Varadi（官方页拼写）、德米斯·哈萨比斯、Sameer Velankar（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Mihaly Varadi, Demis Hassabis, Sameer Velankar”。
